pages.title: electric blast furnace
pages.text: Electric blast furnace is an upgraded version of blast furnace. It has two modes: smelting and co-casting. The principle of smelting is similar to that of a blast furnace, but it has 4 input slots and is 4 times more efficient than a blast furnace. Co-casting can fuse materials to create alloys.

pages.title: steel
pages.text: Steel is made by fusing iron and coal in electric blast furnaces. Each iron ingot and coal can produce 1 steel ingot. Steel is essential to most recipes and was the main material of the first rockets.
